metadata.title: Start-YT-DLPdownloaderGUI
metadata.description: Downloads media from Youtube, also from Facebook and any compatibile Tube, can download torrent files using MAGNET or torrent source. Has WEB Uri validation test. First installs Chocholatey and 'yt-dlp', FFmpeg and Aira2. Has option to check updates for those packages.

findings.title: Dynamic PowerShell code execution
findings.description: Dynamic evaluation can make a script harder to inspect and may enable downloaded or constructed code to run.

evidence.snippet: Set-ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Scope Process -Force; [System.Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [System.Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol -bor 3072; $ScriptBlock = [scriptblock]::Create(((New-Object System.Net.WebClient).DownloadString('https://community.chocolatey.org/install.ps1'))); Invoke-Command -NoNewScope $ScriptBlock -WarningAction SilentlyContinue -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

findings.title: Network retrieval combined with code execution
findings.description: The same file contains both a network retrieval pattern and a dynamic execution pattern. This combination merits review and is not by itself proof of malicious intent.

findings.title: Encoded or compressed content used with dynamic execution
findings.description: Encoded or compressed data is used alongside dynamic evaluation. This can appear in legitimate tooling; review the surrounding logic.
